_readme: Everything on zoisports.com/robrun. Edit, bump `updated`, then run: node tools/build-robrun.mjs. Only put things here the game does not already show (no price lists). Labels: official = Kefir; data = game files via fan wikis; player = player reports; zoi = our advice.

xpjDecoder.name: XP Journal: decoders and base raids

rggMoney.name: ROB RUN GG Wiki: money making

kefirLooty.name: Kefir: First look at Looty Bay (mirror)

wikiRaid.name: ROB RUN Wiki: base defence and raiding

plan.why: The Contraband Workbench has to sit on your own base.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Build the Contraband Workbench and start repacking
plan.why: Cheap to start, and it repacks while you do runs. Players net $10k to $20k a crate.
plan.label: player

plan.do: Open a bank account and launder every sale
plan.why: Banked money can't be stolen by players. Do it after every run, not at the end of the night.
plan.label: official

plan.why: Faster repacks mean more batches per night.
plan.label: data

plan.why: A second crate per batch roughly doubles what one bench makes.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Fuse the building that holds your cargo, then a Personal Alarm
plan.why: Only once cargo sits there long enough to be worth raiding. Clans: Clan Alarm next.
plan.label: zoi

plan.do: Upgrade to a Small House and add a second bench
plan.why: A Trailer fits one workbench; a Small House fits two.
plan.label: player

tips.text: Keep the bench busy. Load crates before every run so it never sits empty.
tips.label: zoi

tips.text: Buy Contraband Cargo from your settlement's seller. Residents get a discount.
tips.label: official

tips.text: Sell cargo in one trip with your crew. Police can seize it on the road.
tips.label: data

tips.text: Never leave cash or cargo at the base or in the trunk.
tips.label: player

tips.text: If you're close to the next Notoriety level, wait to sell big cargo. Level 5 pays 25% more than level 1.
tips.label: data

lastDay.text: Don't start long builds or research. They won't pay back before the raid.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Sell all cargo. Every $500,000 you hold at the wipe is one more year of jail time, up to 40 years.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Banked cash is wiped too, but it still counts toward jail time.
lastDay.label: official

lastDay.text: Agree with your crew on which realm you all join next.
lastDay.label: data

planNote.text: Already own a Grow Room? Filling its tables beats the bench. See Best runs.
planNote.label: player

bestRuns.lead: Cash per hour, ranked. All of these are player reports, one player's or squad's result, not a promise.

ranked.name: Full Grow Room
ranked.note: 6 tables, 36 bushes. Grows while you rob or are offline, and a death doesn't stop it. One table of 6 bushes is ~$34k / hour.

ranked.name: Store runs
ranked.note: One solo player made $600k in 3 hours.

ranked.name: Cop shift
ranked.note: Best report: $100k in 45 min. A normal shift is closer to $30k. You keep your own gear.

ranked.name: Contraband bench
ranked.note: $10k to $20k net per 30-minute crate. Passive, so stack it with everything above.

perJob.name: Bank heist
perJob.note: Squad job. Needs a Drill, an ID Card and a Mini Drill, and the drill alerts the whole city.

perJob.name: ATM restock event
perJob.note: How often it happens isn't known.

tips.text: Pick stores by safes per minute, not size. A jewelry store with two safes beats a hotel with five cabinets.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Sell at your district's hub when you can. Kefir says it can pay well above Looty Bay.
tips.label: official

tips.text: Plant bushes instead of selling them. A planted bush keeps paying every harvest. Late in the week, sell it.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Leave at about $100k in the bag. Smaller cash-outs lose less when a squad shows up.
tips.label: player

bestRuns.unknown: Nobody has published reliable per-minute numbers for specific crates or routes, how often a repack comes out as Rarity Cargo, or what the Nov 4 patch did to production payouts.

duo.lead: Two players, one Clan Alarm. Split the jobs so one of you is always free.

items.text: Driver: stays in the car, engine ready, hands empty. Drawing a weapon drops cargo you're carrying.
items.label: player

items.text: Guard: does the store. Break the alarm box and shoot the cameras first, and skip the glass.
items.label: player

items.text: Loot and sell in separate trips, so you rarely lose both.
items.label: player

items.text: Before selling, one of you checks the Fence or Smuggler as a Civilian. Campers wait there.
items.label: player

items.text: It warns both of you the moment a hack starts.
items.label: data

items.text: Whoever is closer goes home. The other one finishes the sale or banks, so the run isn't lost too.
items.label: zoi

items.text: You have time: each decoder takes about 12 seconds at the panel, so a fused building takes minutes.
items.label: player

items.text: After a hack, repair the panel on the spot. Your fuses survive and the defense comes back.
items.label: player

items.text: Both of you launder after every sale. Banked money can't be stolen by players.
items.label: official

items.text: Use your own Laundering Desk; Lenny takes a share.
items.label: player

items.text: Withdraw only what the next buy needs. Cash on you can be taken.
items.label: zoi

raids.lead: Nothing protects an offline base except fuses and alarms. Here's how raiders get in and what to do about it.

items.text: They hack the gate panel from outside, then a building's Security System with decoders until its defense hits zero. Then that building opens for a while.
items.label: player

items.text: One hack opens one building, not the whole base.
items.label: player

items.text: They go for the weakest money buildings first: the Grow Room and Chemical Laboratory have some of the lowest base defense.
items.label: player

items.text: Decoders don't open safes or cage racks. That takes a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: An open door lets anyone who jumps the fence walk straight in.
items.label: player

items.text: Eviction Rights were pulled from barter on Nov 17, for now.
items.label: official

items.text: Best: nowhere. Sell it and bank the cash.
items.label: zoi

items.text: If it has to wait, put it in a cage rack or safe, so a raider also needs a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: Spread cash, loot and cargo over several buildings. Each one needs its own decoders, so raiders run out.
items.label: player

items.text: Not in the car. A trunk can reportedly be opened anywhere.
items.label: player

items.text: Fuse the Grow Room and Chemical Laboratory first. They make the money and open the easiest.
items.label: player

items.text: Fill slots with Fuse I first. It's the cheapest per point; move to bigger fuses when slots run out.
items.label: data

items.text: Put your Clan Alarm on the building that holds the most value. A panel has 3 alarm slots.
items.label: player

items.text: Alarms add no defense. They only warn you.
items.label: data

items.text: Close every door before you log off.
items.label: player
